name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
oracle_text:
During your turn, Kefka has indestructible.
At the beginning of your end step, exile a card at random from each opponent's graveyard. You may cast any number of spells from among cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs. Then each player who owns a spell you cast this way loses life equal to its mana value.
blocked_sentences: Then each player who owns a spell you cast this way loses life equal to its mana value.

needs.what: A selector key that names exactly the cards a free-cast op (`play_exiled`) actually cast during this resolution -- e.g. `{"cast_this_way": "self"}` -- so a following `for_each` can loop them and a `lose_life` inside can use the existing `{"owner_of": "each"}` player spec with `{"mana_value_of": {"binding": "each"}}` as its amount.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `play_exiled` chooses its cards, calls `cast_for_free` on each and binds nothing, so no later effect can see which ones were taken. The closest selector is `exiled_with: "self"`, which is the wrong set in both directions at once: a card that was cast has left exile and no longer matches, and a card the player declined to cast still does -- so it names 'exiled this way' and never 'cast this way'. `was_cast` is a condition about the ability's own source, not a pool, and `snapshot` captures one object chosen in advance rather than an unknown-size set decided mid-resolution.
